notes.title: Série Porradaria: Grande Atualização
notes.notes:
Olá a todos!

Como muitos já sabem, a [b]série Porradaria[/b] foi desenvolvida na engine [b]Game Maker: Studio[/b].

Recentemente, a empresa responsável por essa engine decidiu [b]encerrar o suporte a versão 1[/b], que é justamente a versão usada pela série Porradaria. No entanto, antes de encerrarem o suporte, eles lançaram uma [b]última atualização[/b] que corrigiu vários problemas antigos dessa versão.

Com essa última atualização da engine, claro, também atualizei os jogos e aproveitei a deixa para fazer várias melhorias, dentre elas:
[list]
[*]Novo sistema de controles USB foi implementado*
[*]Agora você pode configurar qualquer botão do controle
[*]Agora controles USB também são compatíveis no Linux
[*]Agora as imagens liberadas nos extras também aparecem na tela final do respectivo ranking em Porradaria 2: PotN**
[*]Corrigido o bug do "missing .exe" em Porradaria Upgrade
[*]Corrigido o bug do "direcional travado" em alguns modelos de controle
[*]Corrigido o slowdown por "excesso de sangue na tela" ao matar muitos inimigos
[/list]
[quote][h1]Observações[/h1]
*Sistema [b]optimizado para controles X-Input[/b]. Controles [b]D-Input[/b] também são compatíveis, mas alguns modelos [b]podem não funcionar corretamente[/b] (ou simplesmente não funcionarem mesmo).

**Caso esteja com o DLC "[b]Sem Censura[/b]" habilitado, você verá as versões [b]sem cortes[/b] das imagens de[b] Rank S[/b].[/quote]

Gostaria de agradecer a todos que me informaram dos problemas que vinham encontrando nesses jogos. Graças a vocês que eu pude corrigi-los.


Obrigado pelo apoio de sempre, meu trabalho é para vocês!

Atenciosamente,
O Desenvolvedor

notes.title: Reajuste de Preços
notes.notes:
Olá a todos!

Adotamos uma política de preços baixos em prol de manter o nosso ideal de [b]jogos acessíveis ao brasileiro[/b], mas infelizmente, para podermos nos manter no mercado atual, tivemos que reajustar o preço de alguns de nossos produtos.

Já faz algum tempo que o dólar está cada vez mais em alta em relação ao real, além da inflação que também está disparando cada vez mais, e a tendência é de ambos continuarem a subir. Mesmo assim, os jogos e DLCs da CleanWaterSoft não estavam acompanhando a real situação econômica do nosso país.

[h1]Porradaria 2: Pagode of the Night[/h1]
Esse jogo teve um reajuste de 100% (isso mesmo), deixando de custar R$9,99 e voltando ao seu preço original de lançamento, R$19,99.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/431220
Contudo, seus DLCs continuarão no mesmo preço atual.

[h1]Fantasya Final Definitiva REMAKE[/h1]
Esse jogo também receberia um reajuste de 100%, passando a custar o preço originalmente planejado para seu lançamento, mas por se tratar de um compilado de dois clássicos nacionais que fizeram parte da historia do RPG Maker no país, ele recebeu um reajuste adicional de 25%, passando a custar R$24,99.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/656120
Lembrando que, o [b]capítulo 1[/b], que corresponde ao primeiro [b]Fantasya Final Definitiva[/b], sempre continuará disponível inteiramente de graça como demonstração.

[h1]Porradaria Fan Pack[/h1]
De modo a manter os preços acessíveis dentro do possível, mesmo depois do aumento de preços, [b]Porradaria Fan Pack[/b] agora passará a ter um desconto de [b]50% para cada produto incluso no pacote[/b], continuando a custar R$29,95 no total.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/2697/Porradaria_Fan_Pack/

Não esqueçam que, caso já tenham algum produto no pacote, você poderá comprá-lo apenas com os produtos que ainda não tem, e cada produto ainda terá com um desconto de 50%.
Por exemplo: se você já possuir Porradaria Upgrade e Porradaria 2, poderá comprar os DLCS desses jogos no pacote por apenas R$14,97, em vez de R$29,97.


Obrigado pelo apoio de sempre, meu trabalho é para vocês!

Atenciosamente,
O Desenvolvedor

notes.title: Dropping Support to English Language
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

CleanWaterSoft is finally dropping support for English and other languages for both [b]Porradaria Upgrade[/b] and [b]Porradaria 2: Pagode of the Night[/b] on Steam.

Since the past year that we are focusing only in the local market for new games and DLCs releases, and now we are also extending this for old products.

So, in order to give a better local support to our Brazilian customers, we will be supporting only the Brazilian Portuguese language from now on, for all of our products available on Steam.

This means that from now on:
[list]
[*]Store pages' descriptions will be available only in Brazilian Portuguese;
[*]News and official announcements will be only in Brazilian Portuguese (unless deemed necessary);
[*]Relevant updates for these games will be available only in Brazilian Portuguese.
[/list]

If you purchased these games before this change, you still can have access to the "last multi-language version" through the "beta tab" in the Steam client.

If you need technical support, you still may use the [u]Suporte Técnico[/u] boards on Steam, but your demand must be at least in English language.


Thanks for your ever support, my work is for you!

Best regards,
The Developer

notes.title: Bundle Kings Scam
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

All the games from Cleanwatersoft stopped being sold on bundles since the past year, but since the past week, the Bundle Kings is selling this bundle below with both Porradaria included.

https://www.bundlekings.com

However, I never allowed this bundle to happen. I contacted them about this matter, they didn't replied me, instead, they started another bundle, now with Porradaria 2 - Vladmirson DLC also included.

https://www.bundlekings.com/bonus-bundle.html

After a extensive investigation of my own, I found from where they got those keys. It was from an [b]old give away[/b] I promoted, with the help of appaboss7 in 2017, to disclose Cleanwatersoft's [url=http://facebook.com/cleanwatersoft]Facebook page[/url].

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10241839/e9b87ed69dd177ef95388c6ced9f68ef27428cd8.png[/img]

All these keys were labelled as "promo", and since the past week, the activation of keys with this label raised greatly.

[b]For this reason, all the keys labelled as [u]promo[/u] will be revoked.[/b]

To not harm those that legitimately activated these keys on the give away, or that spent their money on this bundle before this announcement, only the keys that are not activated yet will be revoked.

Since the past year that I decided to not sell any game on bundles anymore, so any game being sold out of Steam, is being sold without my consent.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10241839/7948908aa096928ad84a5e94ffc1a59c79999324.png[/img]

Here, the bundle promoter is asking you to "help give support to these indie developers". If you really want to give support to Cleanwatersoft, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/cleanwatersoft/]follow us on Steam[/url] to stay in touch with our discounts and new releases, and only purchase our games directly on Steam from now on.

https://store.steampowered.com/developer/cleanwatersoft/


Kind regards,
The Developer

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[h1]Edit[/h1]

Here's the email I sent to bundlekings@gmail.com. I used my personal email from official cleanwatersoft.com domain, it also was redirected to my gmail inbox.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12048210/7793867ec89fcf39e896410a3d0ce1163f780c99.png[/img]

I also sent this very same message through their contact form in their site one day before sending this email.

notes.title: Porradaria 3 and Steam Direct...
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10241839/721f9b0fa196550ace048959a4c3ddf072e51ec4.png[/img]

Hi everyone!

Porradaria 3 development was confirmed and it is right now on Steam Greenlight awaiting for your vote! However...

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=775957558

As you might have heard of, Valve will replace the old Steam Greenlight system with a new one, the [u]Steam Direct[/u]. Developers will have to pay for each game they publish on Steam Store from now on.

Right now Valve is considering a fee between $100 and $5.000 for each game. Depending on the outcome of it, Porradaria 3 might [u]not be released on Steam Store[/u], and I will explain why.

[h1]The Company[/h1]

CleanWaterSoft is a small company from Brazil, the only person working on it right now is the own founder (me). The budget of the company is really low, thus, the source income of the company is also low.

Porradaria Upgrade, the first commercial release, was developed literally with [b]zero[/b] budget. It was developed with the lite version of Game Maker 8, with watermark and all. The first game income was what paid the pro version of Game Maker 8 + the Steam Greenlight fee.

Budget directly affects the sales of a game, hypocrisy would be to say it doesn't. A big budget means a big development team, a more polished product, a big marketing campaign... All of this directly affects any game overall sale, from a small indie from a AAA blockbuster.

[h1]The Competition[/h1]

It's not impossible for an indie game to become a hit and the developer become a millionaire from night to day. There's a lot of good indie games with low budget being released every day, but only a few have the luck of being noticed to become a hit. Most of them becomes hidden and very well buried gems nowadays.

I won't say my games are hidden jewels, it's up to you to decide, but surely, they are a niche of a niche games, with not enough fans to make them be released on Steam Greenlight within two days.

[h1]Economics[/h1]

Brazil is not a well developed country like United States of America, $1 dollar here is equal to R$3,20 reais (our currency). There's a lot of differences between our economics.

The minimum suggested fee of $100 dollars would be R$320 reais, which is about half of the salary the common worker get paid here. The maximum fee of $5.000 would be half the price of a new car here.

There's a joke I saw on internet another day I believe that illustrates well the economic differences.

USA President, in a speech says:

"The American citizen [b]earns $2.000[/b] dollars per month, [b]needs $1.000 to live[/b] and [b]what they do with the remaining[/b] of their money is none of our concern."

Brazil's President, in a speech says:

"The Brazilian citizen [b]earns R$880[/b] reais per month, needs [b]R$2.000 to live[/b] and [b]how they earn the remaining[/b] of this money is none of our concern."

[h1]Conclusion[/h1]

It is still too soon to say anything, however, depending on how Valve will implement Steam Direct, not only Porradaria 3, but any other CleanWaterSoft game [u]won't be released on Steam Store[/u] from now on.

I know there's a lot of persons here eager to play this last sequel of our dear Ninja, so I had to post an explanation here of why it probably won't be released on Steam Store. I hope you understand.

Thanks for your ever support, my work is for you!

Kind regards,
Alysson L. Neto
